And he said, what he had planned in his head from the start, if we got Jim out all safe, was for us to run him down the river on the raft, and have adventures plumb to the mouth of the river, and then tell him about his being free, and take him back up home on a steamboat, in style, and pay him for his lost time, and write word ahead and get out all the niggers around, and have them waltz him into town with a torchlight procession and a brass-band, and then he would be a hero, and so would we. But I reckoned it was about as well the way it was.", "sha256": "6260255f5089962c8c7d453dafa0da5ee9d20c7074ef38f468c2188ba11aaea2", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[2]", "source_html": "The first time I catched Tom private I asked him what was his idea, time of the evasion?—what it was he’d planned to do if the evasion worked all right and he managed to set a nigger free that was already free before? And he said, what he had planned in his head from the start, if we got Jim out all safe, was for us to run him down the river on the raft, and have adventures plumb to the mouth of the river, and then tell him about his being free, and take him back up home on a steamboat, in style, and pay him for his lost time, and write word ahead and get out all the niggers around, and have them waltz him into town with a torchlight procession and a brass-band, and then he would be a hero, and so would we. But I reckoned it was about as well the way it was."}, {"id": "043-046-0003", "tag": "p", "text": "We had Jim out of the chains in no time, and when Aunt Polly and Uncle Silas and Aunt Sally found out how good he helped the doctor nurse Tom, they made a heap of fuss over him, and fixed him up prime, and give him all he wanted to eat, and a good time, and nothing to do. And we had him up to the sick-room, and had a high talk; and Tom give Jim forty dollars for being prisoner for us so patient, and doing it up so good, and Jim was pleased most to death, and busted out, and says:", "sha256": "b4a96e669d8b744c4e1f8c6066ecfe0986179b6e912b3822a3be279640557043", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[3]", "source_html": "We had Jim out of the chains in no time, and when Aunt Polly and Uncle Silas and Aunt Sally found out how good he helped the doctor nurse Tom, they made a heap of fuss over him, and fixed him up prime, and give him all he wanted to eat, and a good time, and nothing to do. And we had him up to the sick-room, and had a high talk; and Tom give Jim forty dollars for being prisoner for us so patient, and doing it up so good, and Jim was pleased most to death, and busted out, and says:"}, {"id": "043-046-0004", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "Tom’s Liberality", "sha256": "e1194af97cebcdae383414809a64b74bb758767cdec545587cbb9649e2de2835", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c43-365", "image_id": "c43-365"}, {"id": "043-046-0005", "tag": "p", "text": "“Dah, now, Huck, what I tell you?—what I tell you up dah on Jackson islan’? I tole you I got a hairy breas’, en what’s de sign un it; en I tole you I ben rich wunst, en gwineter to be rich agin; en it’s come true; en heah she is! Dah, now! doan’ talk to me—signs is signs, mine I tell you; en I knowed jis’ ’s well ’at I ’uz gwineter be rich agin as I’s a-stannin’ heah dis minute!”", "sha256": "1683db71f5368e6d4d2578a5e34f6340baf80af298780c16a9d8c4324628abcf", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[5]", "source_html": "“Dah, now, Huck, what I tell you?—what I tell you up dah on Jackson islan’? I tole you I got a hairy breas’, en what’s de sign un it; en I tole you I ben rich wunst, en gwineter to be rich agin; en it’s come true; en heah she is! Dah, now! doan’ talk to me—signs is signs, mine I tell you; en I knowed jis’ ’s well ’at I ’uz gwineter be rich agin as I’s a-stannin’ heah dis minute!”"}, {"id": "043-046-0006", "tag": "p", "text": "And then Tom he talked along and talked along, and says, le’s all three slide out of here one of these nights and get an outfit, and go for howling adventures amongst the Injuns, over in the Territory, for a couple of weeks or two; and I says, all right, that suits me, but I ain’t got no money for to buy the outfit, and I reckon I couldn’t get none from home, because it’s likely pap’s been back before now, and got it all away from Judge Thatcher and drunk it up.", "sha256": "998f06956ff1848257b60c7d11036f949a482766a6d7a6693d212431f31de95d", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[6]", "source_html": "And then Tom he talked along and talked along, and says, le’s all three slide out of here one of these nights and get an outfit, and go for howling adventures amongst the Injuns, over in the Territory, for a couple of weeks or two; and I says, all right, that suits me, but I ain’t got no money for to buy the outfit, and I reckon I couldn’t get none from home, because it’s likely pap’s been back before now, and got it all away from Judge Thatcher and drunk it up."}, {"id": "043-046-0007", "tag": "p", "text": "“No, he hain’t,” Tom says; “it’s all there yet—six thousand dollars and more; and your pap hain’t ever been back since. Hadn’t when I come away, anyhow.”", "sha256": "3246f503cc3ce6eb233cda9c1b4b0958aa195ee3b5375c8271ad89f5e7b8dbab", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[7]", "source_html": "“No, he hain’t,” Tom says; “it’s all there yet—six thousand dollars and more; and your pap hain’t ever been back since. Hadn’t when I come away, anyhow.”"}, {"id": "043-046-0008", "tag": "p", "text": "Jim says, kind of solemn:", "sha256": "7d63ec1ecab84cf181df72682cf9904820fee5c5c64f4cbbfc2032a8f075e693", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[8]", "source_html": "Jim says, kind of solemn:"}, {"id": "043-046-0009", "tag": "p", "text": "“He ain’t a-comin’ back no mo’, Huck.”", "sha256": "dfa708234a02a760ecc64fde49a2a4949081f648a9708687b8d51e0c1415924c", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[9]", "source_html": "“He ain’t a-comin’ back no mo’, Huck.”"}, {"id": "043-046-0010", "tag": "p", "text": "I says:", "sha256": "0e568af30022d4c6b08be6c92743d85cbf120134610018b892e098e0fe72f7eb", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[10]", "source_html": "I says:"}, {"id": "043-046-0011", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, Jim?”", "sha256": "2a325ea3c83ade8e330c8d160dec1d9d0988bca44aff8d79c5b7c646b2578880", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[11]", "source_html": "“Why, Jim?”"}, {"id": "043-046-0012", "tag": "p", "text": "“Nemmine why, Huck—but he ain’t comin’ back no mo.”", "sha256": "12d96c4a4ed75a2cb9a569420475428f35064d1b3f8fbaea06e684ce8be6e77a", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[12]", "source_html": "“Nemmine why, Huck—but he ain’t comin’ back no mo.”"}, {"id": "043-046-0013", "tag": "p", "text": "But I kept at him; so at last he says:", "sha256": "1cb0d4e1c6d5c80f67bab26861809d4c557e20a098736079e3afd3cc11dcade6", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[13]", "source_html": "But I kept at him; so at last he says:"}, {"id": "043-046-0014", "tag": "p", "text": "“Doan’ you ’member de house dat was float’n down de river, en dey wuz a man in dah, kivered up, en I went in en unkivered him and didn’ let you come in? Well, den, you kin git yo’ money when you wants it, kase dat wuz him.”", "sha256": "b3ec52a74dad72ea6fbb0f2e7689b41e81a2711d909e8a24351029a79c4a94f6", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[14]", "source_html": "“Doan’ you ’member de house dat was float’n down de river, en dey wuz a man in dah, kivered up, en I went in en unkivered him and didn’ let you come in? Well, den, you kin git yo’ money when you wants it, kase dat wuz him.”"}, {"id": "043-046-0015", "tag": "p", "text": "Tom’s most well now, and got his bullet around his neck on a watch-guard for a watch, and is always seeing what time it is, and so there ain’t nothing more to write about, and I am rotten glad of it, because if I’d a knowed what a trouble it was to make a book I wouldn’t a tackled it, and ain’t a-going to no more. But I reckon I got to light out for the Territory ahead of the rest, because Aunt Sally she’s going to adopt me and sivilize me, and I can’t stand it. I been there before.", "sha256": "dfea25a3d39764c22edbe7d8ea481665f5b6467985a68dc97bdbf78cb33d7c24", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[15]", "source_html": "Tom’s most well now, and got his bullet around his neck on a watch-guard for a watch, and is always seeing what time it is, and so there ain’t nothing more to write about, and I am rotten glad of it, because if I’d a knowed what a trouble it was to make a book I wouldn’t a tackled it, and ain’t a-going to no more. But I reckon I got to light out for the Territory ahead of the rest, because Aunt Sally she’s going to adopt me and sivilize me, and I can’t stand it. I been there before."}, {"id": "043-046-0016", "tag": "p", "text": "THE END. YOURS TRULY, HUCK FINN.", "sha256": "6907aa6a583b5b62b1ea51aa4e91527df2dcea7cf2d021e5453c7b3fba6e028b", "source_location": "div.chapter[48]/*[16]", "source_html": "THE END. YOURS TRULY, HUCK FINN."}, {"id": "043-046-0017", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "Yours Truly", "sha256": "09d8daae84cf5941aafc9bb4d1fe736fd152e900dac9e42df6d90916626495c3", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c43-366", "image_id": "c43-366"}], "draft_rows": [{"source_id": "043-046-heading", "target": "ПОСЛЕДНЯЯ ГЛАВА", "source_sha256": "2dc7f0a93119916d9c8bfc5bb0f264e7c892569f6c98158b4e482ab59a5a19e7", "target_id": "ru-043-046-heading", "tag": "heading", "target_sha256": "ef69c3672517433753fa26d790d4a4352978266e741ff8a554c210647de532d8"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0001", "target": "Из рабства. — Выплата пленнику. — С уважением, Гек Финн.", "source_sha256": "0ab92983d9a4d39d44fff616ca1afe50e2fe1bd852f84c1252450ddb522c526c", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0001", "tag": "source_argument", "target_sha256": "87c0d36f7e94f79d2ecb9def30b715c7cf707924bc1a0dfcae32b180525f8a44"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0002", "target": "Впервые, когда я поймал Тома наедине, я спросил его, какова была его задумка, когда он планировал побег? — что он собирался делать, если бы побег удался и ему удалось освободить негра, который и так уже был свободен? И он ответил, что с самого начала задумывал: если мы благополучно вытащим Джима, то отвезём его вниз по реке на плоту, будем переживать приключения вплоть до устья реки, а потом расскажем ему, что он свободен, а потом с шиком отвезти его домой на пароходе, заплатить ему за потерянное время, заранее написать письмо и вытащить оттуда всех негров, чтобы они провели его в город с факельным шествием и духовым оркестром, и тогда он стал бы героем, как и мы. Но я решил, что так, как всё сложилось, было даже лучше.", "source_sha256": "6260255f5089962c8c7d453dafa0da5ee9d20c7074ef38f468c2188ba11aaea2", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0002", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "eaa596f833ab50ec724cd4c828ea731b6093e34ebe115f902a7c6ceeba09401c"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0003", "target": "Мы в мгновение ока освободили Джима от цепей, и когда тётя Полли, дядя Силас и тётя Салли узнали, как он хорошо помог доктору ухаживать за Томом, они устроили вокруг него целую суматоху, привели его в порядок, накормили всем, что он хотел, устроили ему веселье и освободили от всяких дел. Мы привели его в комнату больного и устроили оживлённую беседу; Том дал Джиму сорок долларов за то, что тот так терпеливо сидел у нас в плену и так хорошо справился с этой ролью, и Джим был счастлив до безумия, не выдержал и воскликнул:", "source_sha256": "b4a96e669d8b744c4e1f8c6066ecfe0986179b6e912b3822a3be279640557043", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0003", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "b669c1d0cf09229e5a5f654a9cb29591ac4fdff8ab2255af1beab61b2d5e0052"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0004", "target": "Щедрость Тома", "source_sha256": "e1194af97cebcdae383414809a64b74bb758767cdec545587cbb9649e2de2835", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0004", "tag": "source_caption", "target_sha256": "074643061a4a9d90a66d0725394ecd3bb54d5bf7c0e524f445b44f50497d9807"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0005", "target": "«Да, ну же, Хак, что я тебе говорил? — что я тебе говорил там, на острове Джексон? Я говорил тебе, что у меня волосатая грудь, и какой на ней знак; и я говорил тебе, что я когда-то был богат и снова стану богатым; и это сбылось; и вот она! Ну вот! Не говори со мной — знаки есть знаки, вот что я тебе говорю; и я знал точно так же, что снова стану богатым, как точно знаю, что стою здесь в эту минуту!»", "source_sha256": "1683db71f5368e6d4d2578a5e34f6340baf80af298780c16a9d8c4324628abcf", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0005", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "1ba003c2d1319e8ce8a09d4d446eb47bf42afa31649c99089c1e300a439537dd"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0006", "target": "А потом Том болтал и болтал, и говорит: «Давайте все трое однажды ночью сбежим отсюда, раздобудем снаряжение и отправимся на дикие приключения к индейцам, туда, на Территорию, на пару недель или две»; а я говорю: «Ладно, мне это подходит, но у меня нет денег, чтобы купить снаряжение, и, по-моему, я не смогу достать их из дома, потому что, скорее всего, папа уже вернулся и забрал всё у судьи Тэтчера, а потом всё пропил».", "source_sha256": "998f06956ff1848257b60c7d11036f949a482766a6d7a6693d212431f31de95d", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0006", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "0d839ac6cec5597c5e6741d45768d868b924db3fc1e3a2c40324abfeb260b6ab"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0007", "target": "«Нет, не увёл, — говорит Том, — всё ещё на месте — шесть тысяч долларов и больше; и твой папа с тех пор ни разу не возвращался. По крайней мере, не возвращался, когда я уезжал».", "source_sha256": "3246f503cc3ce6eb233cda9c1b4b0958aa195ee3b5375c8271ad89f5e7b8dbab", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0007", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a0bbc26476f5e396ae751924d733ef884d2a1e28923c264367125fdb8a0e89eb"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0008", "target": "Джим говорит, как бы торжественно:", "source_sha256": "7d63ec1ecab84cf181df72682cf9904820fee5c5c64f4cbbfc2032a8f075e693", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0008", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "6d1e3af74f02f57a7806a8d6c4f820e9dc0407ad11e36bdf233dc33aa31020ff"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0009", "target": "«Он больше не вернётся, Хак».", "source_sha256": "dfa708234a02a760ecc64fde49a2a4949081f648a9708687b8d51e0c1415924c", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0009", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a9326148ee7c851c1b3c306c804b839ba2964c80958dbd5370f45b7a55748549"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0010", "target": "Я говорю:", "source_sha256": "0e568af30022d4c6b08be6c92743d85cbf120134610018b892e098e0fe72f7eb", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0010", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fa163bba54dc6558fc348978f79413775cd345d5e175c50769a5d6e4566f034e"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0011", "target": "«Почему, Джим?»", "source_sha256": "2a325ea3c83ade8e330c8d160dec1d9d0988bca44aff8d79c5b7c646b2578880", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0011", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "debda433e7666fdfdfdc07f8aa993baa110185b5418a90b927e532edd7e94750"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0012", "target": "«Не знаю почему, Хак, но он больше не вернётся».", "source_sha256": "12d96c4a4ed75a2cb9a569420475428f35064d1b3f8fbaea06e684ce8be6e77a", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0012", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "332be7e5af9500bae99bd14355f764ed4fc4a54b8f6a1503f36748c7952e1431"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0013", "target": "Но я не отставал от него; и наконец он говорит:", "source_sha256": "1cb0d4e1c6d5c80f67bab26861809d4c557e20a098736079e3afd3cc11dcade6", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0013", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c7f54331d26a4e3deb1c900e3f56555cbf45453a8da5d7849b6ff2e25586d565"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0014", "target": "«Ты не помнишь тот дом, что плыл по реке, и там был человек, накрытый одеялом, и я залез внутрь, открыл его и не пустил тебя? Ну, тогда можешь забрать свои деньги, когда захочешь, потому что это был он».", "source_sha256": "b3ec52a74dad72ea6fbb0f2e7689b41e81a2711d909e8a24351029a79c4a94f6", "target_id": "ru-043-046-0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "84e4a38000a5d8a7a08f0d6e34189f4ac06fc1ac72bbd96a24676ff730837df1"}, {"source_id": "043-046-0015", "target": "Том теперь в полном порядке, у него пуля на шее на цепочке вместо часов, и он всё время смотрит, который час, так что больше не о чём писать, и я чертовски рад этому, потому что, если бы я знал, какая это мука — писать книгу, я бы не взялся за это и больше не собираюсь.
